epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml at the repository root to start the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint in the docker-compose setup.

slices.title: Create full stack docker-compose configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing docker-compose for this epic, I want to define the frontend and backend services, so that the product can be launched and verified for real.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh repository clone, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When I hit the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK status.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce full stack launch time from >10 mins to <1 min with a single command

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Provide UI to update existing epidemiological materials.
R2: Provide UI to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Implement material update and delete in UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When a user clicks edit and submits changes, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API and updates the view.
Given an existing material, When a user clicks delete, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API and removes it from the list.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to update or delete a material from manual DB intervention to <30 seconds via UI

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease unauthorized access attempts to restricted endpoints from unknown to 0 incidents.
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated access to the catalog.
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in.

slices.title: Enforce authentication for knowledge base access
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to enforce login prompts for unauthenticated users, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to view the catalog, Then they are blocked and redirected to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then the action is blocked and prompts for authentication.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease unauthorized data access from >0 to 0 incidents by enforcing strict route guards
